name: Disable-LLMNR-NBTNS-GPO
description: Creates or updates the 'Hardening - Name Resolution' GPO to disable LLMNR (EnableMulticast=0) and sets NetBIOS over TCP/IP to disabled via DHCP option; links it to the target OU.
content:
param([string]$TargetOU)
Import-Module GroupPolicy
$gpo = Get-GPO -Name 'Hardening - Name Resolution' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if (-not $gpo) { $gpo = New-GPO -Name 'Hardening - Name Resolution' }
Set-GPRegistryValue -Name $gpo.DisplayName -Key 'HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\DNSClient' -ValueName 'EnableMulticast' -Type DWord -Value 0
New-GPLink -Name $gpo.DisplayName -Target $TargetOU -LinkEnabled Yes -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
# Rollback: Remove-GPLink -Name 'Hardening - Name Resolution' -Target $TargetOU

name: Enforce-SMBSigning-GPO
description: Sets RequireSecuritySignature=1 for both the LanmanServer and LanmanWorkstation policy keys in the 'Hardening - SMB' GPO.
content:
param([string]$TargetOU)
Import-Module GroupPolicy
$name = 'Hardening - SMB'
$gpo = Get-GPO -Name $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $gpo) { $gpo = New-GPO -Name $name }
Set-GPRegistryValue -Name $name -Key 'HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters' -ValueName 'RequireSecuritySignature' -Type DWord -Value 1
Set-GPRegistryValue -Name $name -Key 'HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanWorkstation\Parameters' -ValueName 'RequireSecuritySignature' -Type DWord -Value 1
New-GPLink -Name $name -Target $TargetOU -LinkEnabled Yes -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
